title: label.yaml: one planted defect, deliberate change or known baseline quirk

kind.description: defect: planted bug (recall). change: deliberate change, reporting it is a false alarm. baseline: intended quirk of the unmutated app (e.g. a demo page that is broken on purpose); matching findings are excused. natural: a real bug present in every build of the app (found by a system, verified by apps/<app>/verify.ts); finding it counts like finding a planted defect, reported separately as natural recall

difficulty.description: blatant: shows on the main path for any data (a button that does nothing). subtle: shows only for some data, roles or sequences (rounding on some amounts, after an edit, under a filter). Tracks can cap blatant bugs per episode

exposure.description: known: the defect is publicly documented (e.g. Swag Labs' built-in faulty users), so systems may have seen it; scored apart from the novel headline

switch.description: How the runner switches this on. Omitted for baseline labels (always on)

env.description: Environment variables for compose. When several active labels set the same variable, values are joined with commas

exclusive.description: Labels sharing this group can't be active in the same episode

found_by.description: Evidence that counts as finding it; any one entry matches

category.description: Overrides the label category for this entry

also_categories.description: Other categories a reasonable report of this same evidence may use (e.g. a cart not emptied after checkout is functional or consistency)

description_pattern.description: Case-insensitive regular expression the finding's description must match. Use it when two labels share a route and category (always for natural defects), so a finding counts only when it names this symptom. Deterministic and the same for every system

require_locator.description: If true, a selector or region must also match when the entry has one

operator.description: operators/ id this was instantiated from, if any

upstream_ref.description: Where the behaviour lives upstream (file or doc), for reviewers
